description: Count a period stated in days under Fed. R. Civ. P. 6(a)(1). Exclude the trigger day. Count every calendar day, including intermediate Saturdays, Sundays, and legal holidays. Roll only the last day. direction is after or before. days is an integer from 1 to 3660. There is no calendar argument. Legal holidays are the Rule 6(a)(6)(A) days on the federal-office observed weekday, including Juneteenth. This is not Excel WORKDAY. It does not apply state holidays, one-off holidays, clerk inaccessibility, Good Friday, or Inauguration Day, and it does not decide whether a filing is timely.
